subject: Human Body
title: How Vaccines Work
description: A fast breakdown of How Vaccines Work for builders.

hook.text: Vaccines trick your immune system into learning without getting sick. It's a rehearsal for the real fight.

buildup.text: A vaccine introduces a harmless version of a pathogen: dead, weakened, or just a fragment of its surface.

discovery.text: Your immune system responds as if it's a real infection. It makes antibodies and memory cells — without the disease.

twist.text: When the real pathogen arrives, memory cells activate in hours instead of days.

climax.text: Vaccines exploit adaptive immunity's memory. They teach without harm so the body is prepared with experience.

punchline.text: A vaccine is a cheat sheet for your immune system.

quiz.question: How do vaccines protect against disease?
options: By killing all pathogens in the blood immediately
By training the immune system to recognize a pathogen before real infection
By strengthening the skin barrier against viruses
